scenario: [RLOW.6.1.10]: on integer storage `x::<unit>` of a tier-2 unit is its `to_base` over `x` as `Float`, then [LUNI.7.2]'s cast, round half to even. `halved` is a tier-2 unit on `data` whose `to_base` is `x / 2`. Fact 1 holds 3: `to_base` gives 1.5 bits, which the cast takes to 2. Fact 2 holds 5: 2.5 bits, which the cast takes to 2. Rule `conv` compares each with 2 bits and logs both. A truncating cast takes 1.5 to 1 and leaves fact 1 silent; rounding half up takes 2.5 to 3 and leaves fact 2 silent. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete.rlow_6_1_10_int_tier2`, `FN_INT_TO_FLOAT` into the body and `FN_ROUND` out, evaluated by each runtime.
rules_ds:
unit dimension data storage int64 base bit
unit bit: data
unit halved: data:
    to_base:   x / 2
    from_base: x * 2

schema S scope logical:
    id: Int key
    n: Int mutable

rule conv:
    S s where s.n::halved == 2_bit
->
    log info "conv {s.id}"
